In this video we cover:
Unlisted shares in India were once limited to elite, well-connected investors. But with the rise of fintech platforms and social media influencers, access has expanded — along with confusion, volatility, and risk. This video explores how the grey market for unlisted shares operates, the absence of price discovery, and how retail investors are getting caught in unstable valuations. We also examine SEBI’s recent response and why this market may not be as promising as it seems.
